title: eagles rookie report card: titans game
seoTitle: Eagles Rookies vs. Titans: Lemon's Performance & More
subtitle: Makai Lemon's performance and other rookie observations
excerpt: The game against the Tennessee Titans showcased the initial performance of the Eagles' rookies, with a special focus on Makai Lemon and observations on other key.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between the Eagles and the Tennessee Titans, played in intense heat, brought to light the performance of Philadelphia's newly acquired players. While the rookies' impact was limited, the game provided relevant insights into each player's development.

Makai Lemon's Evolving Performance

Makai Lemon, who joined the team in the 2026 draft, had a difficult start to the season. In the first game, he accumulated five negative receiving yards, a result of screen and shuffle passes that didn't work. Against the Titans, another shuffle pass attempt resulted in five lost yards, but this statistic was recorded as a rushing attempt.

However, Lemon achieved his first quality target in the game, converting a 14-yard reception. The play featured good blocking from Jalen Hurts, who hit him in the middle of the field, allowing him to make the catch amidst traffic. This type of play, according to the analysis, is crucial for the role the team expects from Lemon, especially in the slot zone.

The Impact of an Unexpected Defensive Play

In addition to the reception, Lemon contributed defensively by helping to tackle Amani Hooker, preventing a pick-six. The action was highlighted as a “nice play, rook” in the report.

Observations on Other Rookies

  • Cam Jurgens showed a dubious performance as a guard. If the team continues with Drew Kendall at center, Jurgens' dismissal might be considered to advance Micah Morris in the blocking hierarchy.
  • Dallas Goedert remains injured, leaving the Eagles' tight end situation precarious. Even with Zach Ertz's signing, the need for Eli Stowers is evident, although he can only return to active duty starting Week 5.

What to Expect in Upcoming Rounds

With the increasing pace of the game, Lemon is expected to be used more as a central target as Jalen Hurts tends to direct plays to that area. The report indicates that Lemon's performance may improve as the season progresses.

With information from Bleeding Green Nation.
